narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>If one comparison fails, the other two fail too.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Take ten, fifteen and thirty: only the thirty fails.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The other two comparisons for that set still hold.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To test a set, put the lengths in order.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then check only the longest against the other two added.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Try it on six, seven and twelve.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the words only the longest needs a check appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip says that if one comparison fails the other two fail as well, but the two shorter lengths always pass.
